exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: platform.battery_stop_default: {"operator":"below","percent":20,"default":true,"action":"suspend scripting engine and stop all experiments"}
exactCanonicalSetting.sourceClause: below 20 percent by default suspends the scripting engine and stops all running experiments

adjacentConfigurableSetting.relationship: The participant-configurable threshold is preserved separately and is not collapsed into this default-20 binding.

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite numeric current-battery-level value expressed in percentage points, evaluated against the source's default threshold; Android event decoding and participant overrides occur before this decision.
outputBoundary: Suspend the scripting engine and stop all running experiments only below 20 percentage points; at exactly 20 and above, this default battery predicate says to continue.
limitations: This binding does not decode Android battery events, choose a sampling cadence, or infer whether the source device reports integer or fractional percentage points.
No encoded battery range, rounding, measurement tolerance, hysteresis, or debounce behavior is inferred from the source.
Participant threshold configuration, persistence, and selection are represented by the separate configurable setting and are not implemented by this default-value fixture.
Scripting-engine transition idempotence, experiment fanout, resumption after charging, and application lifecycle behavior are not disclosed.
The separate charging-only dataset upload trigger and privacy-rule suspension paths are outside this battery-level predicate.
A missing or nonfinite current battery level fails closed rather than being treated as above the threshold.
